baseColor: Decode sRGB once, then apply linear material/vertex/instance tint and procedural variations. Do not include AO or lightmap illumination.

dataMaps.ao: linear red channel; indirect visibility, not base color
dataMaps.normal: linear RGB tangent normal, preserve handedness and both signed strengths
dataMaps.alpha: linear opacity/mask, preserve cutoff and sidedness

unsupported: Unknown custom shaders fail or are explicitly unavailable. World-space wear, parallax, grass variation, anisotropic normal strength and omitted bump maps require adapters. Texture-only export is not shader parity.

dryGrass.selector: TerrainGenerator CityFloor and GroundTiles meshes only, with Standard/Physical source materials.
dryGrass.semantics: Offline dry lawn aggregate approximation. Remap effective linear roughness into [0.9,1], preserve map variation, UVs, base color and normal maps; nonmetallic. Replaces runtime environment suppression with a broad physical lobe, not measured blade-scale BRDF parity.

legacyBus.selector: Exact legacy Phong material names on bus meshes only; authored Standard/Physical materials are preserved.
legacyBus.semantics: Offline appearance approximation. Phong highlight coefficients are not measured dielectric reflectance. Preserve all authored color, texture, alpha and emission inputs; use restrained GGX lobes instead of promoting bright Phong highlights to mirror-like reflection. City materials are unaffected.
legacyBus.preserved: Glass and mirrors retain their separate existing translations. No invented clearcoat, transmission or emissive fill. Rim base color stays gray.
legacyBus.basis: Paint roughness/F0 and restrained black-trim response follow the runtime bus reflection/material profiles; this does not claim equality between Phong, global HDRI reflection and scene-dependent Cycles reflection.

windowInterior.semantics: Opaque UV-tiled muted room silhouette, deterministic by UV cell. Visual substitute, not measured interiors; no emissive fill or white placeholder.
windowInterior.owner: AI562 production exporter; AI566 isolated laboratory adapter
